name: researchlens-lm-attention-v1
description: Internal multi-paper benchmark corpus: transformer pre-training and efficient-attention papers chosen for overlapping terminology, competing methods, explicit disagreements (e.g. next-sentence prediction), table-heavy results, figures, equations, two-column layouts and one very long paper. This is an INTERNAL benchmark, not an industry-standard one.
license_note: PDFs are downloaded from arXiv for local evaluation only and are git-ignored; only this manifest is committed.
